templates.title: Claude Code Container
templates.name: claude-code
templates.description: Claude Code Container 1.0.28 runs Anthropic Claude Code in a browser terminal and an MCP API.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.label: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key. Leave empty to sign in with OAuth in the web terminal.

env.name: AUTH_PASSWORD
env.label: AUTH_PASSWORD
env.description: Password for the web terminal and bearer token for the MCP API. The container exits while this is empty or still the catalog value. An empty value would otherwise open the API. Replace it in the install form before the first start. CasaOS and ZimaOS edit this literal; they do not substitute Compose variables.

env.name: MCP_ENABLED
env.label: MCP_ENABLED
env.description: Enable the MCP endpoint. Web login still runs when this is false.

env.name: CLAUDE_SESSION_TTL
env.label: CLAUDE_SESSION_TTL
env.description: Seconds of inactivity before the web terminal session is closed.
